title: Dashboard Permissions Scope Bypass Enables Cross‑Dashboard Privilege Escalation
desc: The dashboard permissions API does not verify the target dashboard scope and only checks the dashboards.permissions:* action. As a result, a user who has permission management rights on one dashboard can read and modify permissions on other dashboards. This is an organization‑internal privilege escalation.

This did not leak any annotations that would not otherwise be visible on the public dashboard.
